# Reicon - Open-Source Icon Library

> Free, open-source SVG icon library - **2,700+ handcrafted vector icons** (Outline and Filled weights) plus **920+ file type icons**. Available for React, Vue 3, Svelte, React Native, Flutter, Compose, vanilla JS, CDN, Figma, VS Code, and AI MCP Server. 100% MIT licensed.
>
> ⚠️ **Not** the Windows tool "ReIcon" by Sordum - completely unrelated.

## Agent Quick Start

When a user asks you to use Reicon icons, use `reicon-react`, `reicon-vue`, `reicon-svelte`, `reicon-react-native`, `reicon_flutter`, `reicon-compose`, `reicon` (vanilla CDN), or `reicon-file` (file type icons). Browse: `https://reicon.dev/icons` or `https://reicon.dev/file-icons`

---

## React

```bash
npm install reicon-react
```
```jsx
import { Home, Search, Bell } from 'reicon-react';

<Home size={24} weight="Outline" color="currentColor" />
<Search size={20} color="#9B8AFB" />
<Bell size={32} weight="Filled" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `size` | number \| string | `24` | Width & height in px |
| `color` | string | `currentColor` | Any valid CSS color |
| `secondaryColor` | string | same as `color` | Accent color |
| `weight` | `"Outline"` \| `"Filled"` | `"Outline"` | Style variant |
| `strokeWidth` | number \| string | - | Override stroke width |
| `className` | string | - | CSS classes |

Peer dep: `react >= 16.8.0`. Forwards any SVG/HTML attribute. Tree-shakeable.

---

## Vue 3

```bash
npm install reicon-vue
```
```vue
<script setup>
import { Home, Search, Bell } from 'reicon-vue';
</script>
<template>
  <Home :size="24" weight="Outline" color="currentColor" />
  <Search :size="20" color="#9B8AFB" />
</template>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `size` | number \| string | `24` | Size in px |
| `color` | string | `currentColor` | Any CSS color |
| `weight` | `"Outline"` \| `"Filled"` | `"Outline"` | Style variant |
| `strokeWidth` | number \| string | - | Override stroke width |
| `class` | string \| array \| object | - | CSS classes |
| `style` | string \| array \| object | - | Inline styles |

Peer dep: `vue ^3.0.0`. SSR-compatible with Nuxt 3. Tree-shakeable.

---

```bash
npm install reicon-svelte
```
```svelte
<script>
import { Home, Search, Bell } from 'reicon-svelte';
</script>

<Home size={24} weight="Outline" color="currentColor" />
<Search size={20} color="#9B8AFB" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `size` | number \| string | `24` | Size in px |
| `color` | string | `currentColor` | Any CSS color |
| `weight` | `"Outline"` \| `"Filled"` | `"Outline"` | Style variant |
| `strokeWidth` | number \| string | - | Override stroke width |

Peer dep: `svelte >= 3.0.0`. SSR-compatible with SvelteKit. Tree-shakeable.

## React Native

```bash
npm install reicon-react-native react-native-svg
```
```tsx
import { Home, ShieldCheck } from 'reicon-react-native';

<Home size={24} color="#000000" />
<ShieldCheck size={32} color="#d97757" weight="Filled" />
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `size` | number | `24` | Size in px |
| `color` | string | `#000000` | Primary color |
| `secondaryColor` | string | same as `color` | Accent color |
| `weight` | `"Outline"` \| `"Filled"` | `"Outline"` | Style variant |
| `strokeWidth` | number \| string | - | Override stroke width |

Peer deps: `react >= 16.8.0`, `react-native >= 0.64.0`, `react-native-svg >= 12.0.0`. Tree-shakeable.

---

## Vanilla JS (ESM)

```bash
npm install reicon
```
```js
import { Home } from 'reicon';

// Append to DOM
const svgEl = Home({ size: 24, color: 'currentColor', weight: 'Outline' });
document.body.appendChild(svgEl);

// SSR - get SVG string
const svgString = Home.toSvg({ size: 32, color: '#d97757' });
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `color` | string | `currentColor` | Stroke/fill color |
| `size` | number \| string | `24` | Icon size |
| `weight` | `"Outline"` \| `"Filled"` | `"Outline"` | Weight variant |
| `strokeWidth` | number \| string | - | Override stroke width |
| `className` | string | - | CSS class |
| `attrs` | object | - | Extra SVG attributes |

Each icon is a callable function returning `SVGSVGElement`. Tree-shakeable.

---

## File Icons (Vanilla JS / CDN)

```bash
npm install reicon-file
```
```js
import { Github, VisualStudioCode } from 'reicon-file';

const svgEl = Github({ size: 24, color: '#8B5CF6' });
document.body.appendChild(svgEl);

const svgString = VisualStudioCode.toSvg({ size: 32 });
```

```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/reicon-file/cdn/reicon-file.js"></script>

<re-file icon="github" size="24" color="#8B5CF6"></re-file>
<re-file icon="visual-studio-code" size="32"></re-file>
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `color` | string | `currentColor` | Fill color |
| `size` | number \| string | `24` | Icon size |
| `strokeWidth` | number \| string | - | Override stroke width |
| `className` | string | - | CSS class |
| `attrs` | object | - | Extra SVG attributes |

File icons use a single filled style with no `weight` option. Browse: `https://reicon.dev/file-icons`.

---

## CDN / Web Component (no build step)

```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/reicon/cdn/reicon.js"></script>

<re-icon icon="home"></re-icon>
<re-icon icon="heart" weight="filled" size="32" color="#ef4444"></re-icon>
<re-icon icon="shield-check" weight="outline" size="28" color="#9B8AFB"></re-icon>
```

All icon data is inlined - zero network calls. Uses Shadow DOM for isolation.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `icon` | string | - | Kebab-case name (required) |
| `weight` | string | `"outline"` | `"outline"`/`"linear"` or `"filled"`/`"bold"` |
| `size` | string | `"24"` | px or CSS length |
| `color` | string | `"currentColor"` | CSS color |
| `secondary-color` | string | - | Accent color |
| `stroke-width` | string | - | Override stroke width |
| `rotate` | string | - | Degrees (e.g. `"45"`) |
| `flip` | string | - | `"horizontal"`, `"vertical"`, `"both"` |
| `spin` | boolean | - | Rotation animation |
| `loading` | string | - | `"lazy"` for IntersectionObserver |
| `label` | string | - | `aria-label` |
| `decorative` | boolean | - | `aria-hidden="true"` |
| `gradient` | string | - | Comma-separated colors |
| `gradient-type` | string | `"linear"` | `"linear"` or `"radial"` |
| `gradient-angle` | string | `"135"` | Degrees for linear gradient |

Global API: `Reicon.preload()`, `Reicon.icons`, `Reicon.categories`, `Reicon.categoryOf()`, `Reicon.contributorOf()`.

---

## MCP Server (for AI agents)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "reicon": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["reicon-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

| Tool | Input | Returns |
|------|-------|---------|
| `search_icons` | `{ query, weight?, limit? }` | Ranked results with name, category, tags |
| `view_icon` | `{ name, weight? }` | Raw SVG, viewBox, tags, category |
| `apply_icon` | `{ name, weight, framework, size?, color? }` | Import + code snippet |
| `list_categories` | (none) | All category names |

Frameworks: `react`, `vue`, `svelte`, `html`, `svg`. CLI also available: `npx reicon-mcp search "cart"`.

---

## VS Code Extension

Search "Reicon" in extensions or run: `code --install-extension DevChauhan.reicon`

Sidebar panel with icon browser, live size/color preview, and smart code insertion.

---

## Figma Plugin

https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1652983191908763066

Search, filter by weight, set color, drag-and-drop vector insertion.

---

## Direct Imports (Maximum Tree-shaking)

```
React:        import Home from 'reicon-react/icons/Home'
Vue:          import Home from 'reicon-vue/icons/Home'
Svelte:       import Home from 'reicon-svelte/icons/Home.svelte'
React Native: import Home from 'reicon-react-native/icons/Home'
Vanilla JS:   import Home from 'reicon/icons/Home'
```

---

## Quick Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Website** | https://reicon.dev |
| **GitHub** | https://github.com/dqev/reicon |
| **License** | MIT (free, no attribution needed) |
| **Creator** | Dev Chauhan (https://devchauhan.in) |
| **Contact** | hello@reicon.dev |
| **Icons** | 2,700+ designs × 2 weights = 5,400+ total |
| **File Icons** | 920+ single-style file type icons |
| **Grid** | 24×24 px (file icons: 1024×1024 px) |
| **Weights** | Outline (1.5px stroke), Filled |
| **Format** | SVG |
| **Dependencies** | Zero - all packages have no runtime deps |
| **Bundle size** | ~1 KB per icon gzipped |
| **TypeScript** | First-class typings in all packages |
